answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. This is why the network can stay open without a central gatekeeper: the economics of reputation do the filtering that a trusted authority otherwise would. Consider a marble as the anchor of the cost.
